# 超额功绩任官分夹具；报告者为中国皇帝，tca_meas_actor为本例新建候选。
# LEVEL为核定品级，BASE为基准，BALANCE为待测余额。
# 同一人物先记录基准余额的共用评分，再只改余额比较增量，不复制正式折算公式。
tca_test_check_merit_appointment_score_effect = {
    scope:tca_meas_actor = {
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_approved_level value = $LEVEL$ }
        change_merit_no_experience = { value = $BASE$ subtract = merit }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_meas_before value = appointment_score_governor }
        change_merit_no_experience = { value = $BALANCE$ subtract = merit }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_meas_delta value = { value = appointment_score_governor subtract = scope:tca_meas_before } }
    }
}
